Ident.description:
A name inside one document, matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`.

Names are compared as bytes; there is no case folding and no Unicode
normalisation, so the canonical form of OV-15 stays byte-comparable.

Rule: SB-1.

IslandId.description:
Identifies a scheduling island (`05-module-api.md` MA-27).

Rule: MA-27, X7.

local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `LOCAL` is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-38.

sched.description: The scheduler name, uninterpreted by the Kernel.

description:
An Island declaration: an Executor instance, the components placed on it, and
its optional affinity, real-time policy and preferred batch. Where it lives and
the requirement that every component be placed exactly once are SB-13 and SB-25.

Rule: MA-38.

executor.description: The Executor instance that runs it (MA-38).

rt_policy.description:
Real-time scheduling policy, when declared; MA-39 then requires a budget on
every component (MA-38).

title: IslandDecl
